name: Bottom Navigation Bar
summary: Fixed safe-area-aware mobile navigation landmark containing one native list of persistent destination links, visible labels, optional decorative icons and counts, non-color current-page treatment, normal Link behavior, and target-owned route state.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Labelled fixed mobile navigation landmark with safe-area padding.

anatomy.name: entry
anatomy.description: Native list item containing one destination.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native destination link and complete pointer target.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Decorative destination icon hidden from duplicate name calculation.

anatomy.name: badge
anatomy.description: Compact visual count whose equivalent meaning is included in the containing link name.

states.name: mobileVisible
states.description: Neutral Web mobile visibility default; final breakpoint policy remains page-shell owned.

states.name: itemFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a destination.

behavior.name: mobileNavigation
behavior.description: A flat native list contains ordinary destination links; no tablist/menu/toolbar roles, roving focus, panels, or arrow-key handling are added.

behavior.name: routeOwnership
behavior.description: The target router is the sole current owner and marks zero pending or exactly one resolved current page.

behavior.name: badgeCount
behavior.description: Target state formats the compact visual count, includes equivalent meaning in the link accessible name, hides the visual duplicate, and chooses whether changes require a separate announcement.

behavior.name: safeAreaAndOffset
behavior.description: The surface preserves safe-area padding and 44px targets; the page shell owns bottom content offset and keyboard-viewport coordination.

behavior.name: motionAndContrast
behavior.description: Reduced motion removes authored transitions and forced colors preserves boundary, current, focus, icon, and count distinctions.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name for the mobile navigation region.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-owned native destination list with visible labels, optional decorative icons, current-page markup, and optional count metadata included in link names.

accessibility: Expose the bar as a labelled nav containing one native list of native destination links.
Provide visible localized text labels and hide decorative icons from duplicate accessible-name calculation.
Use aria-current=page for zero unresolved or exactly one resolved current destination and reinforce it without color alone.
Include optional count meaning in the containing link accessible name, hide the visual duplicate, and announce dynamic changes only according to target policy.
Preserve normal Link keyboard behavior, 44px targets, visible focus, safe areas, reduced motion, forced colors, and logical RTL placement.
Do not add tablist, menu, toolbar, roving-focus, panel, or arrow-key semantics.

web.notes: Canonical CSS provides list/link layout, safe-area/touch geometry, current/focus/count/special-media states, and no neutral runtime; the target owns routes, counts, visibility policy, and page offset.

shopify.notes: Liquid should map a merchant menu and current route while target services synchronize cart/customer counts, page-shell offset, and visibility.
